sentences.text: A company can buy thousands of AI licenses while its most useful AI work stays unofficial.
sentences.approvedCue: Set an unused company license beside a worker quietly finishing a real task.

sentences.text: AI Adoption Beyond the Slop follows adoption as growing dependence, far beyond trying a tool.
sentences.approvedCue: Reveal two short labels, Tried and Relied on, beside the worker's actual work.

sentences.text: A purchased license, a clever experiment, and a changed working practice tell very different stories.
sentences.approvedCue: Compare a license receipt, a trial result and a changed routine on one work surface.

sentences.text: The book follows the first users, and the people who help others feel comfortable trying.
sentences.approvedCue: Let a colleague approach the worker and look at the useful result before reaching for the tool.

sentences.text: It asks why someone might rely on AI privately while avoiding the subject with colleagues.
sentences.approvedCue: Show a finished AI-assisted document on the desk while its author hesitates to mention how it was made.

sentences.text: It also examines what happens when polished output arrives faster than professional judgment develops.
sentences.approvedCue: Place the polished document beside an unanswered reviewer question, without a success mark.

sentences.text: These tensions matter to anyone deciding where AI belongs in their own work.
sentences.approvedCue: Return to the worker considering which task to change next.

sentences.text: Start with its stages of adoption, and ask what the loudest examples leave out.
sentences.approvedCue: Keep the visible trial result beside the quieter repeated work, inviting comparison.

defects: Scene 2 'From trial to practice', sentence 2 ('The book follows the first users, and the people who help others feel comfortable trying'), all themes: only one person stands beside a monitor. Neither the first users nor anyone being helped is shown, and the approved cue (a colleague approaches the worker) cannot happen because the worker is absent. The visual does not match the sentence.

Scene 2, sentence 1 ('A purchased license, a clever experiment, and a changed working practice...'), all themes: the whole sentence plays over three bordered text cards on an empty stage. There are no actors or situation, which is the 'interchangeable labelled rectangles' pattern ART_DIRECTION rejects.

Cast continuity, scenes 1-3, all themes: the same figure (teal coat, same face and hair) is the 'colleague' in scenes 1-2 and the 'reviewer' in scene 3. The helpful colleague appears to become the sceptical reviewer, which is an identity error.

Dark theme, scenes 1-4: pale grey arms and legs sit on pale pastel coats (lilac, mint, salmon), so an arm folded across the body nearly disappears. This affects the worker in scenes 1 and 3, the reviewer in scene 3 and the learner in scene 4, and the coat detail line is almost invisible.
Scenes 2-4, all themes: the monitors' stands end in mid-air with no desk under them, while scene 1 uses a desk. Physical support is inconsistent.

Scene 3, sentence 2 ('...polished output arrives faster than professional judgment develops'): the reviewer keeps a calm smile under a 'Reviewer asks / How was it made?' card. The planned 'gentle concern' does not show, and nothing depicts output outpacing judgment.
Phone 393/320 px: the card subtitles ('Draft revised', 'Purchased', 'Still pending') render at about 6-7 px and cannot be read.

defects.title: The permission gap
defects.what: At the sentence midpoint (0:44) the first polished pages fade in on top of the monitor: half-transparent page cards overlap the returning AI window and cross the right bezel (ghost double card), while the magnifier is also a faint ghost. Reads as a rendering glitch at the exact moment the sentence lands.
defects.fix: Emit pages from behind the monitor's right edge (or from the review-table side) at full opacity with a short fade, start the stream after ai-window-2 settles, and finish the loupe appear before the midpoint.

defects.title: The permission gap
defects.what: Eli never examines a page: the magnifier lies flat on the review table, he stands beside the table with hands at his sides and his 'reflect' gesture raises one arm upward away from the page (0:46). The planned 'worried reviewer examining one page with a magnifier while output outpaces judgment' is not enacted; only his worried face carries it.
defects.fix: Put the loupe in Eli's hand over checked-page (arm toward the table, head/gaze down at the page), keep it there while the pile grows; replace the upward reflect gesture with a held, downward examining pose.

defects.title: From trial to practice
defects.what: 'People who help others feel comfortable trying' is not enacted: Elena's invite gesture is hidden behind the table top (no visible hands), Sam stays at his own spot and his reach (0:30) extends to the RIGHT toward Daniel/the calendar, away from the laptop on his left; at the midpoint (0:28) Sam and Daniel wear identical worried frowns although Daniel is planned as curious.
defects.fix: Move Sam to the laptop (or the laptop between Elena and Sam), mirror Sam's gesture so his hand lands on the laptop, raise Elena's inviting hand above the table line toward Sam, and give Daniel a readable curious expression/gaze at the laptop by the midpoint.

defects.title: The permission gap
defects.what: At the midpoint (0:37) the private-use/avoidance moment has not happened: the AI window is still open, Daniel grins next to the empty second table about 400 px away without asking, and Elena glares. The question, Elena's worried recoil and the window closing all start at ~3.2 s of a 5.7 s sentence, so the central 'permission gap' beat is only visible in the last 40% of the line.
defects.fix: Bring Daniel to conversational distance by ~1.5 s, start his question and Elena's quick window close/turn by ~2 s so the midpoint shows the concealment.

defects.what: Elena's 'determined' expression renders as an angry glare (sharp V brows, flat mouth) in scene 1 S1 (quiet absorbed work, 'wry curiosity') and scene 3 opening, contradicting the emotional plan.
defects.fix: Use neutral/curious with gaze on the monitor for absorbed work; reserve determined for a resolve beat.

defects.fix: Shrink it and anchor it to the growing pile/monitor (e.g. small labels on the pile), or drop it and let the pile carry dependence.

defects.what: In-art crate label spells 'AI licences' while the narration caption says 'licenses' on the same frame.

defects.title: Look beneath the noise

defects.fix: Show one continuous rising stage path across the spread; have Elena look toward or carry the magnifier to the quiet pile.

defects.what: Eli has a detached white pill shape on his chest below the scarf that reads as a stray artifact.
